metadata.description: A human identity, one of the two forms of Identity. Holds no secret material; credentials are referenced. When federated, it references the external IdP subject.

handle.description: Login handle, unique within the implementation.

authenticated_by.description: The auth provider or DirectoryService that authenticates this identity; default is the built-in provider.

credential_ref.description: Reference to the CredentialRef that proves this identity; custody stays with the store.

external_subject.description: The external IdP subject id when federated; a reference, resolved not stored.

actor_uuid.description: The stable actor id referenced by role-assignments and by grouping (access_grouping) membership.

relationships.description: Member of an access grouping (access_grouping) or IdentityGroup; membership drives role binding (the RBAC bridge — `Grouping` subject_bindings plus the function-capability matrix).

adopts.role: identity/subject vocabulary (userName, displayName, active, userType; a person and a service account are both Users)

context.purpose: Models a human account — the actor that gets authenticated, authorized, and audited.
context.plain_description: One human's identity: its `handle` (the login name) and its `actor_type` — always `human`, and required alongside the handle — plus display name, email, status, and how they authenticate (the built-in provider by default, or a directory/IdP when federated). It carries no secret material — a password or key is referenced through a CredentialRef, never stored. Every audited action and role assignment points back at this record's stable actor id.
use_when: You need human accounts as records that role assignments and audit trails reference.
You need a federated user tied to their external IdP subject without copying the IdP's data.
not_for: Automation, agents, or API-key holders — Identity.ServiceAccount.
The credential itself — CredentialRef; a person references credentials, never contains them.
The directory server — DirectoryService is the server; this is one identity in it.
works_with: IdentityGroup — memberships that drive role binding.
CredentialRef — the person's credentials, by reference.
DirectoryService — the external authenticator when federated.
